base_prompt: Everything is visibly handmade from cut paper, cardboard and natural fibers: low relief, visible cut edges, real micro-shadows, sober cold Andean highland light. Subtle stepped stop-motion cadence, very gentle camera. Characters only breathe, blink and gesture softly — they do NOT talk. No morphing, no melting, no photorealism, no 3D render look, no text, no extra characters appearing.

clips.prompt: Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation. The still highland lagoon at dawn: cotton-fiber mist drifts slowly across the dark layered-paper water; paper frailejon plants sway almost imperceptibly; tiny ripples cross the surface. Slow gentle push-in.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation. Macro shot of the muddy paper shore: dormant paper seeds half-buried near the flat stone; a thin veil of mist slides past; water laps softly at the edge in cut-paper ripples. Very slow lateral drift to the right.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation. The cut-paper mother, waist-deep, rises very slowly and serenely from the dark layered-paper lagoon holding the small boy's hand; concentric cut-paper ripples expand gently; wisps of cotton mist drift low. Gentle slow push-in.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation. The mother and the small boy walk slowly out of the water onto the shore, wet paper garments clinging modestly, leaving first footprints in the mud; soft ripples follow them; mist parts gently. Slow lateral tracking.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation. In the flat green valley, the woman weaves straw onto the round hut roof while the small boy stacks firewood by the three-stone hearth; thin paper smoke rises and curls; grass sways slightly. Gentle push-in.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation, night scene. The woman and the boy sit by the hearth under a paper starfield; cut-paper flames flicker gently, thin smoke curls up, the hanging seed pouch sways slightly; stars twinkle softly. Very slow push-in, warm firelight on cold night.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation. The grown companion carries a log toward the hut while the woman pours paper seeds into the woven pouch; they exchange a calm look; hearth smoke drifts. Gentle push-in.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation. Wide highland valley at dusk dotted with new round straw huts, each with a thin column of hearth smoke; small families walk between houses; smoke drifts, warm light shifts slowly. Slow aerial-like lateral drift.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation. A file of families walks along the dirt path between green hills, the woman leading and pointing toward a distant watered valley; the seed pouch swings on her shoulder; garments sway with each slow step; clouds drift. Slow lateral tracking following the walk.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation. Close on the woman's bare paper feet crossing the small stream stepping on flat stones, cut-paper water rippling around each slow step, the hem of her raw-cotton manta swaying. Slow tilt up along the walk.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation. In the village courtyard the elder-to-be woman shows a young woman how to pour seeds into a clay vessel; hands move gently and deliberately; the frame loom stands behind; hearth smoke drifts. Gentle push-in.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation. Two pairs of paper hands pour water from one clay vessel into another, sharing it; cut-paper water drops fall slowly; behind, an open path runs between young crops. Slow push-in on the hands.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation. Close portrait of the elder woman with serene paper wrinkles and grey braid; she blinks slowly and breathes calmly watching her grown village; mist and thin hearth smoke drift behind. Very slow push-in.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation. The descendants gather quietly around the elder woman; clay vessels with seeds rest on a blanket; she slowly raises her hand pointing toward the far misty mountains; garments and smoke sway gently. Gentle slow arc around the group.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation. A quiet multitude climbs the highland grass toward the lagoon through mist, carrying bundles and helping the elders; the elder couple walks ahead arm in arm with slow steps; mist drifts across the frailejones. Slow lateral tracking.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation. By the water's edge, the elder woman gently places the woven seed pouch into a young woman's open hands; both hold it a still moment; mist moves slowly over the dark water behind. Gentle push-in on the hands and faces.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation. Seen from the shore, the two elders holding hands walk slowly deeper into the dark layered-paper water until waist-deep; concentric cut-paper ripples widen around them; the silent community watches from the misty shore. Slow solemn push-in.

Handcrafted paper-maquette stop-motion animation. Overhead view of the dark lagoon: two large serene paper serpents — one dark green, one deep ochre — glide slowly in a wide circle leaving concentric cut-paper ripples, then begin to sink as the ripples close and mist settles; the lagoon returns to stillness. Slow overhead drift.
